{{BossList|Ref = Only the first '''Corrupted Terror''' is a [[Boss]] enemy.|Default}} }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Terror''' was a large, tough enemy that spawns in Wave 6 of the [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] and [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]]. It can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It had significantly higher health than every enemy before it while being slow to compensate. It always spawned with [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]]. ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Terror''' is a large entity with dark purple skin. It has multiple neon purple veins on its body. It does not have legs, instead having a black spine. On its left arm, it has a rusty metal claw while on its right arm it has an exposed bone. On its head, it has neon purple eyes and blackened teeth. It has multiple spikes and tentacles which are the same color as its skin on its body. It wears a rusty black helmet ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] should be used to take down the '''Corrupted Terror'''. **Towers like the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Mortar]] due to their big range can be used to take down the '''Corrupted Terror''' without fear of it going out of range *Due to it having [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze]] and [[Stun Immunity]], towers like [[Freezer]] and [[Cryomancer]] cannot freeze or chill it, knockback towers cannot knock it back, while towers like [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]] and [[Trapper]] can only slow it down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail6.png|'''Corrupted Terror''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CorruptedTerrorWalk.gif|Walking animation (4 October 2025 – Present) CorruptedTerrorDeath.gif|Death animation (Unused) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCorrutpedTerror.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CorruptedTerrorIconIG.png|'''Corrupted Terror''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Corrupted Terror''' is a corrupted version of the [[Rotting Terror]]. *The '''Corrupted Terror''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' -
